objective: Test a collision-free explicit parent/move residual over the frozen live NNUE on existing V9 and browser-confusion legal-sibling labels, without generating more teacher data or changing the deployed evaluator.

not_a_repeat.closed_scalar_lane: The prior board/HalfKP sibling lanes changed a child-position scalar evaluator and lost held-out top-1 or direct play.
not_a_repeat.closed_hash_lane: The prior 128 KiB head was a signed feature-hashed linear model, did not use live child value, and failed browser and cross-distribution static gates.
not_a_repeat.new_hypothesis: Use the exact live int16 child evaluation as a frozen value anchor and learn only a non-hashed explicit parent/move residual with a nonlinear 32-unit head.
forbidden_retries: no extra seed, epoch extension, feature variant, or threshold change after a static rejection
no teacher regeneration for this pilot
no runtime integration, match, or deployment before every static gate passes

claim_boundary: A pass is static root-ordering proxy evidence only. It is not playing-strength, node-count, speed, browser-runtime, live-weight, or deployment evidence.

live_nnue.role: frozen exact int16 child-value anchor; never trainable or rewritten

v9_training.candidate_coverage: depth-14 proposal plus independently depth-16-rescored played move; 2-13 candidates

browser_training.candidate_coverage: every rules-complete legal move independently depth-12 rescored

browser_reject.role: previously observed reject-only set; forbidden for epoch selection

v9_reject.role: previously observed cross-distribution reject-only set; forbidden for epoch selection

semantic_partition.policy: protect both reject sets; browser training wins remaining cross-training conflicts; drop the whole lower-priority parent
semantic_partition.fit_tune: Inside each retained domain, union all parents sharing a game_id or any parent/child semantic_position_id. Canonicalize each whole connected component as sorted games, parents, and semantic IDs; assign tune iff the first 8 bytes of sha256(seed:sha256(canonical_component_json)) modulo 5 equal zero, otherwise fit. Fail if either side is empty; require zero game and semantic overlap.
semantic_partition.fit_tune_receipt: Record component counts, parent/game counts, zero overlaps, and sha256 of the sorted component-digest/assignment rows for each domain.

parent.piece_square: 2268 collision-free normalized piece-square indices -> 12 dimensions, summed

move: from square 0-80 plus one drop token
destination relation to both kings as two explicit 17x17 tables
piece occupancy in eight origin and eight destination neighbors
architecture.head: 73 explicit inputs -> tanh 32 -> one clipped residual in [-1200,1200] cp
architecture.production_nnue_asset: unchanged exact 1185988-byte file; head is separate and cannot enter a leaf/TT value

loss.parent_weighting: each parent contributes equally regardless of candidate count
loss.listwise: cross entropy from teacher softmax to combined-score softmax at 100 cp
loss.pair: strict logistic ordering for teacher gaps >=50 cp, weight 0.10

training.selection_parent_sampling: each selection epoch visits every browser fit parent once and a deterministic 3:1 V9 fit sample
training.epoch_selection: maximize the worst per-domain tune top-1 gain, then worst pair gain, then worst regret change
training.refit: restart from the same seed and train all retained training parents for the selected epoch count
training.refit_parent_coverage: all retained V9 and browser parents exactly once per epoch
training.refit_scheduler: same CosineAnnealingLR recipe and original preregistered T_max=8; stop after the selected epoch without shortening the schedule

browser_reject.mean_regret: must not exceed exact live baseline on the same parents

v9_reject.mean_regret: must not exceed exact live baseline on the same parents

failure_conditions: STOP before optimization on any byte/hash/count/schema/source-profile/rank/child-identity/semantic-partition drift
STOP this exact recipe if either reject distribution misses top-1, pair, or regret requirements
STOP before research WASM if float-to-int16 or artifact-size gates fail
A pass permits only an off-by-default research-WASM root-ordering node/time test
Do not modify public/shogi-nnue-weights.bin, production WASM, workers, or live code from this runner
Do not add seeds, epochs, threshold changes, or more teacher labels after a failure
